cards.design_implication: A study design aiming to capture phagophore formation mechanisms should consider targeting conditions analogous to starvation and may need to account for ER association as a baseline structural feature of the phagophore.
does_not_establish: Specific molecular mediators of the contact sites.
cards.evidence_excerpt: As previously reported, all phagophores associate with the ER. The surface area of phagophores in contact with the ER decreases gradually as they mature into autophagosomes and autolysosomes. However, the ER still associates with 92% of autophagosomes and 79% of autolysosomes, suggesting that most autophagosomes remain on the ER after closure and even when they fuse with lysosomes.
limitations: Findings are based on abstract-level reporting.
The observation is specific to the reported experimental condition (cells starved 30 min).
cards.statement: The supplied text reports that all phagophores associate with the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) in cells starved for 30 minutes, and suggests that most autophagosomes remain on the ER after closure.
